description: The latest AI Fear & Greed reading (0-100) for AI stocks overall or one layer, with components (null = not measured that day), optional score history (up to 365 days) and the dates the history starts and ends. Use for sentiment questions.

historyDays.description: Also return the index score series for this many calendar days (365 at most; data.historyRange says where the full history starts).

layer.description: Layer slug for a per-layer reading; omit for the whole index.

name: get_fear_greed
title: AI Fear & Greed Index
